verdict.rationale: Riveter has a documented scrape endpoint that turns a URL into 'easily parseable text', so an output-format axis applies to it. The evidence never shows a parameter for choosing markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter output. A single fixed text output does not let a developer choose the returned format.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter
